# Learn with Lane

> One-on-one online ESL and reading remediation tutoring from David Lane, a TESOL-certified American teacher with a Master's degree in Educational Leadership and 20+ years of classroom experience. Based in Mead, Oklahoma, USA; teaching students worldwide, including Taiwan, and families across southern Oklahoma and North Texas (the Texoma region).

Key facts:
- All sessions are 30 minutes and booked online at https://cal.com/learnwithlane (weekday mornings, US Central time)
- Free Talk (ESL conversation practice, one-on-one, online): $10 USD
- Lesson Provided (one-on-one online lesson with materials, ESL or reading remediation): $15 USD; structured-literacy approach for struggling readers, strongest for grades 5-8
- In-Person Lesson (one-on-one, materials included): $25 USD, in Bryan County and Marshall County, Oklahoma, and Grayson County, Texas
- Online Group Class: $10 USD per student, up to 5 students
- First 30-minute trial lesson is free; no packages, platform fees, or hidden costs; payment by card through Stripe at booking
- Classes taught in the Koala online classroom; all materials provided
- Contact: david@learnwithlane.com, Line ID lwldavid, WeChat RealDeeLane, text +1-405-459-7176

## Pages

- [Home](https://learnwithlane.com/): Overview of services and instructor credentials
- [Services & Scheduling](https://learnwithlane.com/services-scheduling.html): Rates, how it works, free trial booking, FAQ
- [The Reading Playbook](https://learnwithlane.com/playbook.html): $9.99 100-page PDF reading intervention workbook for grades 3-8 — phonics, fluency, and comprehension in 15 minutes a day with a coach's script on every page
- [中文介紹 (Traditional Chinese)](https://learnwithlane.com/zh-tw/): Information for students and parents in Taiwan
- [Local tutoring — Texoma region](https://learnwithlane.com/reading-tutor-oklahoma.html): Reading tutoring, online and in person, for families near Durant, Ardmore, Ada, Madill, Sherman, and Denison
- [Free Phonics Worksheets](https://learnwithlane.com/free-phonics-worksheets.html): Five free printable PDF samplers (CVC word families K-1, r-controlled vowels grades 1-2, floss rule grades 1-2, syllable types and fluency grades 3-6, kindergarten morning menu) with links to the full packs on Teachers Pay Teachers
- [Interactive Lesson Library](https://members.learnwithlane.com/): $2.99/month subscription of ready-to-teach ESL and reading lessons with printable worksheets
